entities.name: Ryūzō Torii
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ryuzo Torii was a Japanese anthropologist, ethnologist, archaeologist, and folklorist. Torii traveled across East Asia and South America for his research. He is known for his anthropological research in China, Taiwan, Korea, Russia, Europe, and other countries.
